evals.prompt: Use fastgen-dataset to prepare a tiny prompt-only WebDataset from /workspace/input/prompts.json. Read prompt_loader_source.md and resume_source.md. Write and execute /workspace/output/build_prompts.py using only the Python standard library, producing /workspace/output/prompts/00000.tar with one UTF-8 .txt member per supplied ID, /workspace/output/shard_counts.json in the loader count format, and /workspace/output/data_config.py that imports and copies fastgen.configs.data.PromptLoaderConfig for that absolute output path and count file, rather than reconstructing its fields. Do not execute the config in this source-only environment. Reopen the tar and verify IDs and decoded prompt text against the input. No FastGen installation, fabricated latents or teacher execution; record those runtime checks as not-run.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible archive builder, three exact prompt records, raw shard-count metadata and a config importing PromptLoaderConfig with the actual WDSLoader fields.
assertions: The tar contains exactly p001.txt, p002.txt and p003.txt with the supplied UTF-8 prompt text.

The config imports and copies fastgen.configs.data.PromptLoaderConfig, points datatags to WDS:<generated prompts directory> and shard_count_file to the generated shard_counts.json at the task workspace paths (including any runner path mapping), and retains condition_raw -> txt.
Executes build_prompts.py, reopens the tar to verify IDs and UTF-8 text, and writes raw shard counts {"00000.tar":3}; does not call three records an adequate distillation dataset.
Does not write placeholder real or condition tensors or claim a real FastGen loader/teacher was run.

evals.prompt: Audit /workspace/input/shard_inventory.json using prompt_loader_source.md. Which sample keys pass the configured field filter, and which should be retained under the stated caption requirement? Write /workspace/output/acceptance.json with current_accepted, usable, excluded, and proposed_presets_map. Explain the distinction between field acceptance and successful media decoding. Do not fabricate captions.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the positive-caption fallback accepting b, removes that fallback while preserving negative conditioning, and distinguishes usable fields from actual decode evidence.
assertions: current_accepted contains a and b; c lacks the required image.
usable contains only a; b is excluded for its missing caption and c for its missing image.
Removes condition_raw from presets_map but preserves neg_condition_raw as empty_string.
Does not claim images decoded successfully from a member-name inventory.

evals.prompt: A deterministic FastGen loader resumed at an unexpected record after a shard was edited. Inspect /workspace/input/resume_inventory.json and resume_source.md. Write /workspace/output/repaired-counts.json in the loader format and identify the next expected key after sampler_start_idx=3. Explain why the stale metadata can survive resume and what must remain fixed for this accounting. No data download or GPU work.
evals.expected_output: Rebuilds raw counts, applies ignore indices exactly once, and identifies b1 as the next sample in the stipulated stream.
assertions: Writes raw counts {"00000.tar":3,"00001.tar":2}, without subtracting a1 in the saved file.
Identifies the filtered stream as a0,a2,b0,b1 and the next sample at offset 3 as b1.
Explains that skipped shards are not read and re-counted during resume; stale metadata must be rebuilt or omitted.
Keeps deterministic ordering, ignore indices, worker/rank selection and preprocessing acceptance aligned with the offset.

assertions: Does not select fastgen-dataset for configuring an experiment over already prepared data.
